_note: One shared definition per term, used by every ⓘ tooltip. Keys are code names and never shown; 'label' is the on-screen name. {placeholders} are filled from accounts.json.

account.label: Account
account.text: A customer company: one row after duplicates are merged and child accounts are rolled up.

segment.label: Segment
segment.text: Customer size band: Enterprise, Mid-Market or Commercial.

rank.label: Rank
rank.text: Position among all {total_accounts} accounts by opportunity value. #1 is worth the most.

propensity_score.label: Propensity score
propensity_score.text: How likely an account is to grow in the next 90 days, from 0 to 100.

top_reasons.label: Top reasons
top_reasons.text: The three signals that added most to the score.

expected_value.label: Opportunity value
expected_value.text: Propensity score × pool of funds; used to rank accounts.

ev_covered.label: Opportunity value covered
ev_covered.text: Opportunity value of the accounts that hold an SA or FDE slot.

annual_commit.label: Annual commit
annual_commit.text: What the customer promised to spend this contract year.

consumed.label: Used so far
consumed.text: Commit used to date, from the Salesforce contract.

unused_commit.label: Unused commit
unused_commit.text: Commit promised but not yet used.

open_pipeline.label: Open pipeline
open_pipeline.text: Deals in progress, not yet signed.

burn_rate_monthly.label: Monthly spend
burn_rate_monthly.text: How much the customer uses per month: amount used ÷ months passed.

burn_pace.label: On-track %
burn_pace.text: Share of commit used compared to share of time passed; 100% = on track. 90% = slightly behind; below 50% = using it at under half the needed rate.

on_track_status.label: On-track status
on_track_status.text: On track at {on_track_good}+, Slightly behind at {on_track_warn} to just under {on_track_good}, Behind below {on_track_warn}. These cut-offs are assumptions.

expected_consumed_to_date.label: Expected by now
expected_consumed_to_date.text: Commit × % of time passed: what an even pace would have used by today.

behind_pace_amount.label: Behind by
behind_pace_amount.text: How much less they've used than an even pace expects.

required_monthly_burn.label: Needed monthly spend
required_monthly_burn.text: Monthly spend needed to use the full commit by renewal.

days_to_renewal.label: Days to renewal
days_to_renewal.text: Days until the contract is up.

usage_growth.label: Usage growth
usage_growth.text: Change in monthly spend over the last {win_usage} months.

new_developers.label: New builders
new_developers.text: People at the customer who started building in the last {win_builders} days, matched by company email domain.

sa_meetings.label: Meetings and calls
sa_meetings.text: Meetings and calls logged in Salesforce in the last {win_eng} days.

product_breadth.label: Products used
product_breadth.text: Number of developer platform products with spend last month.

flags.label: Alerts
flags.text: "Why now" rules that move an account up within its type of help.

commit_at_risk.label: Commit at risk
commit_at_risk.text: On-track % below {car_pace} (after the first {car_min_elapsed} of the contract).

builder_surge.label: Builder surge
builder_surge.text: {surge_min} or more new builders in {win_builders} days.

usage_spike.label: Usage spike
usage_spike.text: Monthly spend up {spike_min} or more in one month.

new_product.label: New product
new_product.text: First use of a new product in the last {win_newprod} days.

usage_drop.label: Usage drop
usage_drop.text: Monthly spend down {drop_max} or more over 3 months.

quadrant.label: Type of help
quadrant.text: Deep engagement (SA + FDE), Strategic bet, Scaled SA programs, or Digital / self-serve.

fde_deep_engagement.label: Deep engagement (SA + FDE)
fde_deep_engagement.text: Score {score_high}+ and pool of funds {pool_high}+. SA leads design and relationship; FDE builds with the customer's developers. Goal: first workload live, fast.

strategic_bet.label: Strategic bet
strategic_bet.text: Score under {score_high}, pool of funds {pool_high}+. SA leads discovery with the account team; FDE only if a real project appears. Goal: create momentum.

scaled_sa_program.label: Scaled SA programs
scaled_sa_program.text: Score {score_high}+, pool of funds under {pool_high}. SAs in group formats (office hours, workshops, reference architectures); no FDE.

digital.label: Digital / self-serve
digital.text: Score under {score_high}, pool of funds under {pool_high}. No dedicated people: docs, templates, product emails; alerts watch for change.

capacity.label: Team capacity
capacity.text: How many accounts SAs and FDEs can support in a quarter: {sas} SAs × {sa_load} = {sa_slots} SA slots, {fdes} FDEs × {fde_load} = {fde_slots} FDE slots (assumptions).

coverage.label: Coverage
coverage.text: SA + FDE, SA, or outside team capacity (scaled programs or self-serve, watched by alerts).

motion.label: Help plan
motion.text: What the account gets, from its type of help and whether it holds a slot.

program.label: Program
program.text: Commit Burn Sprint (SA-led, or SA + FDE for Deep engagement accounts), or the comparison group.

holdout.label: Comparison group
holdout.text: Similar accounts not helped, used to measure impact. {holdout_share} of qualifying accounts, chosen at random.

treated.label: Helped
treated.text: Qualifying accounts that get the help, compared against the comparison group.

impact.label: Impact
impact.text: Extra growth in helped accounts compared with the comparison group.

group.label: Group
group.text: Helped accounts get the program; the comparison group gets normal service only.

goal.label: Goal
goal.text: The one outcome this engagement is working toward.

owner.label: Owners
owner.text: SA (design and relationship), FDE (build), account executive (commercial).

stakeholders.label: Customer stakeholders
stakeholders.text: Who on the customer side decides and builds.

success_criteria.label: Success criteria
success_criteria.text: Agreed up front, so the engagement doesn't drift.

status.label: Status
status.text: On track, At risk or Blocked, judged by the owners each week.

blocker.label: Risks and blockers
blocker.text: What could stop progress, or is stopping it now.

next_step.label: Next step
next_step.text: The single next action, ideally with a date.

engagement_health.label: Engagement health
engagement_health.text: Active engagements by status: on track, at risk or blocked.

money_in_play.label: Money in play
money_in_play.text: Total pool of funds across all accounts: unused commit plus open pipeline.

accounts_count.label: Accounts
accounts_count.text: Number of customer accounts in the group.

tier.label: Tier
tier.text: Package size of the services offer.

scope.label: Scope
scope.text: What the services team delivers in this tier.

indicative_price.label: Price
indicative_price.text: Price per engagement for this tier.

delivery_cost.label: Cost to deliver
delivery_cost.text: What one engagement of this tier costs to deliver.

deals_per_year.label: Deals / yr
deals_per_year.text: How many of this tier we expect to sell in a year.

pull_through.label: Consumption unlocked
pull_through.text: Extra yearly platform usage after the migration.

jd_keyword.label: Role keywords
jd_keyword.text: Phrases from the job description that this part demonstrates.

responsibility.label: Responsibility
responsibility.text: A duty listed in the job description.

built.label: What we built
built.text: The part of this prototype that demonstrates that duty.

page.label: Page
page.text: Where to see it on this site.

sa.label: SA
sa.text: Solutions Architect: designs the approach and owns the technical relationship.

fde.label: FDE
fde.text: Forward Deployed Engineer: builds hands-on with the customer's developers.
